name: Multi-Resolution Sparse Hash Grid
definition: A sparse volumetric representation using a single flat hash table to store voxel blocks of varying internal resolutions but constant metric size. Blocks are allocated from resolution-specific heaps.
summary: The Multi-Resolution Sparse Hash Grid is a GPU-accelerated volumetric representation that stores active voxel blocks of varying resolutions in a flat hash table, achieving constant-time access without hierarchical overhead.
